bugs_found: compound_interest uses exponent n + t instead of n * t, producing materially wrong interest results
years and compounds_per_year are coerced with int(), silently truncating fractional inputs instead of validating/rejecting them
loan_payment months is coerced with int(), silently truncating fractional month inputs
transfer does not normalize amount to Decimal, so float/string inputs can raise TypeError or behave inconsistently with other functions
transfer is not atomic: if crediting account_to fails after debiting account_from, balances can be left inconsistent
missing finite/NaN/Infinity validation across monetary values and rates can allow invalid Decimal states or unexpected exceptions
fx_convert does not validate exchange rate positivity or finiteness, allowing negative, zero, NaN, or infinite rates to produce invalid conversions
apply_fee can return a negative net amount when minimum fee exceeds amount, which may be unacceptable for finance flows
